title: Meghalaya Tour Package
overview: Discover the Abode of Clouds: trek to the bio-engineered Double Decker Living Root Bridge, boat on the crystal-clear Umngot river in Dawki, stand before soaring waterfalls in Cherrapunji, and experience Scotland of the East in Shillong.
highlights: 2 Nights Cherrapunji + 1 Night Shnongpdeng / Dawki + 2 Nights Shillong
Double Decker Living Root Bridge trek in Nongriat
Boating on glass-like clear Umngot River in Dawki
Nohkalikai Falls, Mawsmai Cave, and Seven Sisters Falls
Cleanest village Mawlynnong and Umiam Lake boat ride
inclusions: 5 Nights stay in premium hill resorts and riverside eco-camps
Dedicated private AC cab from Guwahati to Guwahati
All toll, fuel, parking, and driver allowances
exclusions: Boating fees in Dawki and entry fees at caves and waterfalls
Guide fee for root bridge trek (can be arranged on spot)

itinerary.title: Guwahati Arrival, Umiam Lake & Drive to Shillong
itinerary.description: Pickup at Guwahati Airport and drive to Shillong. Stop at the vast, serene Umiam Lake (Barapani) for watersports and photography. Check in to your boutique hotel in Shillong.
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Umiam Lake watersports and panoramic viewpoint
itinerary.eveningActivity: Police Bazar shopping and live music cafe in Shillong

itinerary.title: Shillong to Cherrapunji (Sohra) Waterfalls & Caves
itinerary.description: Drive along cloud-covered mountain ridges to Cherrapunji. Visit Elephant Falls, the roaring Nohkalikai Falls (tallest plunge waterfall in India), Mawsmai limestone cave, and Seven Sisters Falls.
itinerary.morningActivity: Drive to Cherrapunji with Elephant Falls stop
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Nohkalikai Falls viewpoint and Mawsmai cave exploration
itinerary.eveningActivity: Check-in to resort overlooking the gorge & campfire
itinerary.stay: Polo Orchid Resort / Jiva Resort 4★, Cherrapunji

itinerary.title: Double Decker Living Root Bridge & Rainbow Falls Trek
itinerary.description: Trek down into the rainforest to witness the extraordinary Double Decker Living Root Bridge grown over centuries by the Khasi tribe. Optional trek extension to the turquoise pool of Rainbow Falls.
itinerary.morningActivity: Morning descent through Tyrna village to Nongriat
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Swim in natural pools and admire the living bridge
itinerary.eveningActivity: Ascend back and relax with hot tea at your resort
itinerary.stay: Polo Orchid Resort / Jiva Resort 4★, Cherrapunji

itinerary.title: Mawlynnong Clean Village & Dawki Umngot River Boating
itinerary.description: Visit Mawlynnong, celebrated as Asia’s cleanest village. Continue to Dawki on the Indo-Bangladesh border for boating on the crystal-clear Umngot River. Stay in cozy riverside luxury tents in Shnongpdeng.
itinerary.morningActivity: Mawlynnong village walk & single living root bridge
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Boating on transparent waters of Umngot River
itinerary.eveningActivity: Bonfire and riverside camping under the stars

itinerary.title: Laitlum Canyons & Return to Shillong
itinerary.description: Drive back to Shillong via the dramatic rolling abyss of Laitlum Grand Canyons. Visit Don Bosco Museum of Indigenous Cultures and Cathedral of Mary Help of Christians.
itinerary.morningActivity: Scenic morning drive to Laitlum Canyons
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Don Bosco Cultural Museum in Shillong
itinerary.eveningActivity: Cafe evening at Dylan’s Cafe or Cloud 9 lounge

itinerary.title: Shillong to Kamakhya Temple & Guwahati Departure
itinerary.description: Drive down to Guwahati. Visit the sacred Kamakhya Devi Temple on Nilachal Hill before drop-off at Guwahati Airport.
